detail.title: Mechanisms of Autocatalytic Memory and Network Persistence
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the stoichiometric and algebraic conditions underlying chemical memory in autocatalytic reaction networks, utilizing newly collected source evidence to substantiate memory mechanisms.

detail.title: Mechanisms of Autocatalytic Memory
detail.summary: Stoichiometric submatrix criteria and algebraic conditions characterize irreducible autocatalytic subnetworks that support persistent chemical memory states, distinguishing true history-dependent memory from transient hysteresis.
detail.reason: Updating notebook findings with newly retrieved stoichiometric evidence regarding autocatalytic reaction network memory.
